scope: Registered hair production experiments. All candidates excluded from gameplay. No individual fitting, translations, alpha repairs or threshold changes.

records.prompt:
Use case: precise registered-layer edit for a hand-painted game character.
Output asset: ONLY the SHORT CURLY HAIR LAYER for the sixteen bodies in reference 1, on true transparent alpha. Keep the entire 1536 x 1536 canvas and exact 4x4 cell coordinates (384 pixels per cell).
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET AND EXACT GEOMETRY REFERENCE: sixteen bald Solar Friends body poses in the already prepared common coordinate frame. Input 2 is the same geometry with GREEN ALLOWED-HAIR REGIONS, a mandatory placement guide only. Input 3 is BENTO, a PAINTED STYLE AND SHORT CURLY HAIR MATERIAL reference only; do not copy his head sizes, body positions, clothes, tools or stool.
Imagine adding restrained short dark-brown curls directly onto each bald scalp of input 1, following its crown, back of head, forehead hairline and visible ear opening. Then return ONLY that added hair as a registered transparent layer: erase every original body, skin pixel, face, ear, neck, clothing, shoe and prop. No opaque scalp, ear, skin-coloured fragment, face, eyebrows, beard or backing shape beneath the hair. Forehead/face/ear openings stay transparent. Hair is a small cap hugging the actual scalp, not a detached wig, hat or full head.
Each of the 16 caps must sit on that exact body's crown without recentering within its cell. The seated and leaning heads move; match their actual position and tilt. Do not spread caps evenly as a generic contact sheet. Most of the canvas must remain empty transparent space. No trimming, bounding-box fitting, independent normalization, atlas rearrangement or scale changes.
Warm painted edges, broad illustrated dark-brown shading, a few readable soft curl clusters and upper-left daylight as in Bento. Low detail legible at 48-pixel resident size. No shiny plastic, photoreal hair strands or noisy microtexture.
All hair pixels must lie in these x,y,width,height rectangles on the 1536 canvas, row-major:
[184.5,21,102,90],[556.5,21,102,90],[949.5,21,102,90],[1329,21,102,90],
[151.5,409.5,102,90],[529.5,411,102,90],[918,414,102,90],[1338,466.5,102,90],
[150,780,102,90],[532.5,784.5,102,90],[915,781.5,102,90],[1300.5,780,102,90],
[105,1200,102,90],[529.5,1222.5,102,90],[880.5,1206,102,90],[1266,1207.5,102,90].
These rectangles are outer limits, NOT shapes to fill: follow the actual scalp, keep faces open, and leave adequate alpha gaps. Never draw green boxes, grids, labels, text, shadows, ground, background colour or checkerboard. Return one exact-size transparent hair atlas, not bodies with hair.
records.findings: Returned 1254 square instead of 1536. All sixteen diagnostic coverage checks fail. Direct overlays put hair on faces/necks and expose bald crowns. No correction or gameplay integration.

records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Registered modular game sprite layer.
Reference 1 is the exact edit target: a bald standing resident on a 1254 x 1254 transparent canvas. Reference 2 marks the allowed hair region in green; it is only a placement guide. Reference 3 supplies the warm painted short brown curly hair style only.
Paint restrained short dark brown curls fitting the scalp of reference 1, then return ONLY that added hair layer, leaving all body, skin, face, ears, clothing and boots fully transparent. Preserve exact canvas coordinates and size, with the hair located at the top of the original head, approximately x 530–790 and y 80–250. Keep the forehead, eyes and ear opening transparent. Hair follows the three-quarter right-facing scalp; no head-shaped opaque backing, face, eyebrows or skin fragments.
One small cap near the top of a mostly empty transparent canvas, NOT a centered enlarged wig. Keep all hair within x490 y39 width333 height294. Do not fill this rectangle; follow the actual crown and hairline. No guides, labels, grid, ground, shadows or background. Painted broad curl clusters and upper-left illumination matching reference 3, readable at 48px resident size. Exact registration to reference 1 is essential.
records.findings: Correct canvas size and closer registration, but exposed crown, ear notch too low, and hanging back curl. Coverage 0.9393 is below unchanged 0.98 threshold.

records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct one registered transparent hair layer.
Input 1 is the exact bald body geometry target. Input 2 is a rejected hair-only attempt: its ear notch hangs too low and its top leaves the bald crown exposed. Preserve the 1254-square canvas and painted brown curls, but repaint the hair to hug input 1's scalp. Crown must cover x550–750 near y105, with hair starting around y80. Hairline should arch above eyebrows, keeping eyes and forehead open; back hair ends at the visible ear's upper edge around y270–295, NOT y400. Visible left ear is near x575 y287 and must remain uncovered with a transparent notch there. Short tidy curls, no long dangling sideburn/loop. Whole hair within x490–820, y60–330.
Return ONLY hair pixels at these exact original coordinates, all skin/body/face/ear/clothes transparent. No head backing, skin fragments, guides, labels, ground, shadow, resizing, recentering or crop. Most canvas stays empty transparent. Warm broad painted shading matching Solar Friends. This is an overlay on input 1, not a standalone centered wig.
records.findings: Crown coverage improved and ear notch raised. Rectangle coverage 0.9906 passes but does not prove fit: visible background crescent remains behind/below ear and curls extend too far down the back. Single standing pose only; not approved or integrated.
